name: Drip webform handler
project_description: Drip webform handler adds a single Webform handler plugin (id drip_webform_handler, "Drip.com Webform Handler") that posts Webform submissions to the Drip email-marketing/CRM platform as subscriber records. The handler is configured per webform: an administrator supplies a Drip API token and numeric account ID, optional pipe-separated tags and a GDPR consent value, then maps webform textfield/email elements onto Drip subscriber fields (email, name, address, phone, etc.). On each submission the handler builds a Drip subscribers dataset from the mapped values and POSTs it via the drewm/drip PHP client. It depends on the Webform module and the drewm/drip Composer library, and supports Drupal 9, 10 and 11.
